messages:
ravi.sales: BetaCorp wants POC environment torn down and final artifacts delivered. Need quick owners for: hosted API key revocation, dedicated pool decommission, VPC peering removal, and dataset/model deletion vs export. Can someone pick this up?

nate.engineering: I can own the infra side (keys + pool + routing). Quick clarifying q: do they want the uploaded models exported first or permanently deleted? Marta, can you confirm with BetaCorp?

marta.custsuccess: BetaCorp replied: export models to an S3 we provide for 48h then delete. They want immediate API key revoke and pool shutdown within 48 hours. Also ask for a deletion certificate and MD5/SHA256 hashes for exported files.

priya.security: We require a signed short waiver for <90-day retention on the export S3. If they want export encrypted, we will use their KMS CMK and record the key id. Also: log retention minimum is 7 days for audit; if they insist on <7d we need Legal sign-off.

deploy-bot: Created task: BETA-POC-1804205432-export-and-teardown (assignee: nate.engineering)

nate.engineering: Proposed runbook (high-level):
1) Create temporary S3 export bucket (customer-owned or our ephemeral with their KMS).
2) rsync model artifacts + datasets -> s3://beta-poc-export-temp (capture checksums).
3) Revoke hosted API keys.
4) Drain dedicated pool, wait for 0 sessions, then delete pool.
5) Remove VPC peering / VPN creds and clean routing table.
6) Purge KV cache + workspace blobs.
7) Upload deletion receipts + checksums and send to BetaCorp for sign-off.

Commands I'll run from bastion (example):
```
# revoke key
rwctl keys revoke --id=beta_poc_key_01 --admin
# drain pool
rwctl pool update --id=ded-beta-01 --setting drain=true
# delete after drain
rwctl pool delete --id=ded-beta-01
# export artifacts
rwctl workspace export --workspace beta-poc --dest s3://beta-poc-export-temp --encrypt-with-cmk=arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd
```

laura.sre: Couple of production notes: - Monitor GPU jobs: `kubectl get pods -l workspace=beta-poc` until zero. - Check egress rules after peering removal; sometimes routes linger in edge-proxy. - Keep autoscaler logs for 14 days. I'll help verify.

priya.security: When you create the export, include an integrity manifest: list of files + SHA256 + size. After deletion, include S3 delete markers and a signed receipt from the operator. Security will verify receipts against manifest and KMS metadata.

marta.custsuccess: BetaCorp: "We confirm KMS export + we accept 48h hold on the export bucket, then delete. No legal hold." They also asked to stop billing for Dedicated pool after deletion timestamp and to include final usage in closing invoice.

ravi.sales: Good. Nate, can you schedule the execution for 2026-11-01 01:00 UTC? Keep within their 48h request. Also loop finance for proration.

nate.engineering: Scheduling 2026-11-01T01:00Z. I'll perform export, post checksums, then revoke keys and drain pool. After deletion I'll rotate any admin tokens used during the process.

deploy-bot: Task updated: BETA-POC-1804205432-export-and-teardown (deadline: 2026-11-01T01:00:00Z)

laura.sre: Post-delete verification checklist I'll run: 1) no pods with `workspace=beta-poc`. 2) no gateway routes for beta-poc. 3) ACLs removed from VPC peering. 4) KV cache scan returns 0 keys matching `beta:*`. Will sign off on verification.

priya.security: Reminder: If any custom models were fine-tuned using customer data we need explicit confirmation that exported artifacts contain no training data or that customer okayed including it. Marta, confirm with BetaCorp on that point.

marta.custsuccess: BetaCorp confirms models include only synthetic fine-tune — they are fine with export and deletion. Written confirmation saved in ticket.

nate.engineering: After export I'll attach: export manifest, checksums, command logs, S3 lifecycle config (auto-delete after 48h), pool deletion logs, and key revoke response. I'll upload to internal ticket BETA-POC-1804205432 and email BetaCorp a signed deletion certificate with SHA256 list.

priya.security: We'll run a light audit after artifacts uploaded. If all good, security@redwood.ai will mark workspace cleared. Please CC us on the customer acceptance email.

ravi.sales: Thanks all. Owners recapped: export + revoke + delete = nate.engineering; cust liaison = marta.custsuccess; security & audit = priya.security; SRE verification = laura.sre. Closing once BetaCorp signs deletion cert and we upload receipts.

deploy-bot: Reminder: attach all artifacts to task BETA-POC-1804205432 for compliance.
